description: Active National Weather Service alerts for one US state or territory code, as issued. A US source: not an official alerting channel, and not for Canadian locations (use the Canada weather alerts tool). Free. Unaltered copy of the issuer's own notice with the issuer's name and times; ArrowMem adds no assessment.

area.description: Two letter US state or territory code, for example TX.

name: get_us_weather_alerts
